top_signals.title: Oil Rises as Houthis Attack Two Saudi Ports on Red Sea
top_signals.summary: Oil extended gains as Iran-backed Houthi rebels continued to target Saudi Arabia, including a refinery at Ras Tanura and the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan. Meanwhile, the United Arab Emirates said it plans to expand power and water desalination on its eastern coast, beyond the Strait of Hormuz, as war exposes Persian Gulf vulnerabilities. Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Turkey’s Traders See Slower Rate Cut Pace as Reserves Shrink
top_signals.summary: Traders are dialing back bets on a December interest-rate cut in Turkey following a sharp drop in central bank reserves, raising concerns that policymakers may have a harder time supporting the lira.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Tim Hortons China Is Said to Weigh Options Including Stake Sale
top_signals.summary: TH International Ltd., which operates Tim Hortons coffee shops in Greater China, is exploring options that may lead to a stake sale, according to people familiar with the matter.
